- [LADP.2.2.3] **Schema evolution:** none while an engine runs. The engine
  refuses a schema registration once it has emitted its first stream event
  ([NFCT.1.1]), so the adapter's schemas are the ones it derived at connect. An
  attribute that first appears after that has no slot: the adapter must leave
  it out of the facts it asserts, and it reaches rules only through a schema
  that declares it, registered when an engine is next set up.
